info.title: Qovia API
info.summary: Public web data API for AI: 164 endpoints, one key, one JSON envelope.
info.description:
Public web data for AI agents and developers: social, e-commerce and web platforms behind one API key and one JSON envelope.

- **Base URL:** `https://api.qovia.ai`
- **Auth:** `Authorization: Bearer <API key>` (or `x-api-key: <API key>`). Create keys at https://qovia.ai/console/?tab=keys.
- **Requests:** GET endpoints take query parameters, POST endpoints a JSON object body. Unknown parameters are rejected with 400 `invalid_params`.
- **Responses:** HTTP 200 with `{"request_id", "data", "meta"}`. An empty result is still 200, with `meta.empty: true` and `data` empty or null. Errors are `{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id", "support"}}`; branch on `code`.
- **Billing (USD):** a new account gets 50 trial calls on any endpoint (`meta.trial_calls_remaining` counts down); after that, a prepaid balance. Only successful, non-empty results are charged or counted, and errors and empty results are not.
- **Rate limits:** 60 requests per minute per account (600 after the first top-up); some endpoints also have a global per-second cap (429 `endpoint_busy`). Honour `Retry-After`.
- `/v1` only takes GET and POST: other methods (e.g. PUT, DELETE) get a framework 405 `{"detail": "Method Not Allowed"}`, and an unexpected server error may be a plain-text 500. Neither is charged.

Docs: https://qovia.ai/docs/ · API reference: https://qovia.ai/docs/api-reference/ · Chinese: https://qovia.ai/zh/docs/

get.description: Buyer reviews of a Taobao or Tmall item, newest first, 20 per page: text and time, positive / neutral / negative rating, SKU, the buyer's nickname (masked by Taobao) and member level, photos and videos, the follow-up review and shop replies. item_id takes Taobao and Tmall item IDs alike. Default positive reviews without text are skipped unless they carry a follow-up. Stop paging when has_more is false. An item without reviews, or one that does not exist, answers empty and is not charged.

get.description: Buyer reviews of a Taobao or Tmall item, returned as the platform answers in JSON: the comments list (20 per page, each with text and time, rating, SKU, the buyer's nickname, photos and videos, follow-up review, shop reply, likes), plus the review total, maxPage, the popular review keywords (first page only) and hasNextPage. item_id takes Taobao and Tmall item IDs alike; page starts at 1; stop paging when hasNextPage is false. It usually answers in about 3 seconds. Only an answer with data is charged; an item without reviews, or an error, is not.

get.description: Buyer reviews of a JD.com product, newest first, 10 per page: text and time, 1-5 star rating, variant and SKU ID, the buyer's nickname (mostly masked by JD), anonymity, IP location, full-size photos, helpful votes and the shop's reply. By default only this SKU's reviews; with only_this_sku false, every variant of the product. max_page tells how far paging goes (often far fewer pages than the review total); stop when has_more is false. A SKU without reviews, or one that does not exist, answers empty and is not charged.

parameters.description: JD.com SKU ID (the number in item.jd.com/<SKU>.html)
parameters.x-qovia-description-zh: 京东商品 SKU ID（商品链接 item.jd.com/<SKU>.html 里的数字）

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, from 1, up to the max_page of the previous answer; stop when has_more is false
parameters.x-qovia-description-zh: 页码，从 1 开始，不超过上一页返回的 max_page；has_more 为 false 时停止

parameters.name: only_this_sku
parameters.description: true (default) returns this SKU's reviews only; false returns the reviews of every variant (colour, size, ...) of the product
parameters.x-qovia-description-zh: true（默认）只看这个 SKU 的评价；false 返回同一商品所有规格（颜色、尺码等）的评价

get.x-qovia-description-zh: 京东商品的买家评价，从新到旧，每页 10 条：评价内容和时间、1–5 星评分、规格和 SKU ID、买家昵称（多数已由京东打码）、匿名标记、IP 属地、晒图（原图）、有用数和商家回复。 默认只看这个 SKU 的评价，only_this_sku 为 false 时返回同一商品所有规格的评价。 可翻页数见 max_page（常远少于评价总数），has_more 为 false 时停止。没有评价或 SKU 不存在时返回空结果，不计费。

billed.description: Whether this call was charged to the balance; `false` for empty results.

charged_usd.description: Amount charged in USD, 6 decimals; `"0.000000"` when nothing was charged.

empty.description: The result is empty: not charged.

request_id.description: The call's ID (its usage record), also in the `X-Request-Id` header and in the console usage log.

data.description: The endpoint's data; see each endpoint's response example. An empty result may be an empty structure (e.g. empty `items`) or `null`; check `meta.empty`.

code.description: The error code; see the error table. Branch on `code`.

message.description: A short English explanation. One code can have several messages (the error table lists them all), so do not branch on it. Never contains the data source's own error text.

support.description: Where to get help (Telegram); include the `request_id` so we can find the call.

X-Request-Id.description: Same as `request_id` in the body. For a reserved call (success, empty, or a failure after reservation) it is the usage record ID; a request refused before reservation keeps the `X-Request-Id` you sent, or gets a generated one.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current 60-second window.

X-Qovia-Charged.description: Charged for this call, USD, 6 decimals; `0.000000` when nothing was charged or it was refunded.

invalid_params.summary: The parameters failed validation: a required one is missing, a type or format is wrong, an array has more items than allowed, an unknown one was sent, or the POST body is not a JSON object. An error in one parameter starts with its name (`item_id: …`); a missing or unknown parameter starts with `params: …`.

error.message: <param>: <reason>

upstream_rejected.summary: The data source rejected these parameters (well-formed, but not accepted); refunded.

error.message: the data source rejected these parameters; not charged

invalid_api_key.summary: The API key is missing, malformed, unknown, revoked or expired.

error.message: missing or invalid API key

insufficient_balance.summary: The balance cannot pay for this call; top up first.

error.message: insufficient balance for this request
account is disabled

scope_denied.summary: This API key lacks the scope the endpoint requires.

error.message: this API key does not have scope <scope>

endpoint_not_found.summary: No such endpoint; check the method and path.

error.message: no endpoint <METHOD> <path>

not_found.summary: The data source has no such item (deleted, or the ID does not exist); refunded.

error.message: the data source has no such item; not charged

method_not_allowed.summary: The path exists but takes another method; the `Allow` header names it.

error.message: use <METHODS>
<id> has been retired

TooManyRequests.description: Codes: too_many_auth_failures, rate_limited, too_many_unbilled, endpoint_busy. Never charged.

too_many_auth_failures.summary: 30 failed authentications from this IP within a minute; try again in 60 seconds.

error.message: too many failed authentications; try again later

rate_limited.summary: Over the account's per-minute limit (sliding 60-second window); wait for `Retry-After`.

error.message: rate limit exceeded

too_many_unbilled.summary: In the last 10 minutes at least 50 of your calls to data sources, and over 80% of them, came back empty, not found or rejected; slow down.

error.message: too many recent requests came back empty, not found or rejected; slow down. Not charged

endpoint_busy.summary: The endpoint's per-second capacity across all users is full; retry in 1 second. This does not count toward your per-minute limit.

error.message: <id> is at capacity; retry shortly
the data source failed; not charged

ServiceUnavailable.description: Codes: endpoint_unavailable, upstream_busy, upstream_error. Never charged.

endpoint_unavailable.summary: The endpoint is not available right now (no data source connected yet, or no price configured); nothing ran.

error.message: <id> is temporarily unavailable

upstream_busy.summary: The data source is busy or cooling down; refunded. Retry after `Retry-After`.

error.message: the data source is busy; retry later; not charged
the data source failed; not charged

upstream_timeout.summary: The data source timed out; refunded.

error.message: the data source timed out; not charged

reservation_expired.summary: The call took too long and was refunded automatically; no data is returned.

error.message: the request took too long and was not charged
